name: ChronoFrame
short_desc: Self-hosted photo gallery with EXIF, geolocation, and an explore map.
author: Timothy Yin
description: ChronoFrame is a self-hosted personal gallery for managing and sharing photos. It parses EXIF metadata, supports Live/Motion Photos, recognizes shooting locations, and presents everything on a timeline and an explore map. This install uses local storage under the app's data directory; S3 and OpenList backends are available via environment overrides. Sign in with the admin email and password you set during install.
